system.description: Common Specialist Base List (Elemental Companion) 5.6.1 - Elemental Counters. Identifying and then countering an opposing spell by overpowering it with elemental force from the caster's own Source Element, Main Element, or Triad, of increasing spell level, plus draining a spell's power and converting a Source Element spell to the caster's Main Element. Common to every Elemental Specialist. Special notes from the source: elemental breath weapons can be countered with this list (breath weapon level = creature's level); a counter spell of insufficient level does nothing at all (it isn't a partial success); if Arcane magic (Aether/Nether) is used in the campaign, Counter Element spells can affect it, treating an Arcane elemental spell as 3 times its normal level for countering, or as its real level if countered simultaneously by three casters each countering one element of a triad. Optional rules: a too-low-level counter spell can still partially degrade the target spell (-75 to attack rolls/25% duration at 1 level short, -50/50% at 3 levels short, -25/75% at 4-5 levels short, no effect at 6+); counters can stack toward a single higher-level spell (two Counter Element II spells could together counter a 4th level spell); and counter spells themselves can be resisted with a -50 to the target's Resistance Roll.
Caster determines the realm, element and spell classification of target spell.

Caster channels elemental energy from his Main Element at target spell. This effect nullifies up to a 2nd level class "E" spell from the caster's Source Element. Caster must make a successful Directed Spells maneuver (i.e., make an attack against the caster of the target spell using the appropriate elemental attack table). If the attack is successful (delivers hits) then the maneuver succeeds in countering the spell the same round it is cast. If the spell is not cast directly at the caster then the caster must spend an additional 20% action to monitor spell casting. Target spell receives no RR.
As Counter Source II, except it affects any element within the caster's elemental Triad.

Drains power from a spell of the caster's main element. For every 10% failure spell is reduced by one level. If spell level is reduced to 0 then the spell is cancelled. Otherwise the effect of the spell is reduced accordingly (GM's discretion). For most spells, this would reduce the caster's level for RRs, spell duration, etc.... Caster gains 1 PP for every 2 levels by which the spell is reduced.
As Counter Source II, except it affects up to 5th level spells.
As Counter Source II, except it affects spells from the elements not of the caster's triad.
As Counter Triad II, except up to 5th level spells can be affected.
Converts a spell of the caster's Source Element to change its elemental make-up to that of the caster's Main Element. Effects are up to the GM.
As Counter Source II, except it affects 7th level spells.
As Counter Element II, except up to 5th level spells can be affected.
As Counter Triad II, except up to 7th level spells can be affected.
[RR Mod: -10] As Power Drain I, except spell level is reduced by 1 for every 5% failure.
As Counter Source II, except it affects 10th level spells.
As Counter Element II, except up to 7th level spells can be affected.
As Counter Triad II, except up to 10th level spells can be affected.
[RR Mod: -20] As Power Drain I, except spell level is reduced by 2 for every 5% failure.
As Counter Source II, except it affects 15th level spells.

Allows the caster to store a Counter Spell from this list. Spell is activated when the first spell of the appropriate type targets or affects the caster. No other spells from this list may be cast while this spell is active; doing so dissipates this spell. If a Counter Element spell is used the caster must specify the Element that this spell is waiting for.
As Counter Element II, except up to 10th level spells can be affected.
As Counter Triad II, except up to 15th level spells can be affected.

As Counter Source II, except any level of spell may be affected. PP's spent on this spell must be greater than or equal to the spell to be countered. Increasing Power Points increases the level of this spell. Adjust the spell casting rolls accordingly.
As Counter Element II, except that up to 15th level spells can be affected.
As Counter Source True, except this spell may be used to cancel spells from any element in the caster's triad. This spell must be 3 levels higher than the spell to be cancelled or it fails.
